messages.content: What were the most impactful cases handled by law firm ABC in the year 2020?

function.name: case_info_get
function.description: Retrieve case details including the judgement from a case id. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

case_id.description: The unique id for the case.

case_year.description: The year when the case was conducted.

judge_name.description: The judge's name in the case.

message.content:
I’m happy to help you identify the key cases your firm worked on in 2020—but I’ll need a bit more detail first:

1. **Which cases would you like me to look up?**  
   If you have a list of case identifiers (e.g., docket numbers) or even just the names/subjects of the matters, please share them so I can pull the relevant judgments.

2. **Any particular criteria for “impactful”?**  
   For example, do you mean high‑profile media coverage, significant legal precedent set, substantial financial awards, regulatory influence, etc.? Knowing this will let me rank the cases appropriately.

Once I have those specifics, I can fetch the detailed case records using our internal database and summarize why each one stands out as particularly influential during 2020.
